tokens.npc_dota_hero_primal_beast_bio:
Though the deterioration of the Mistwood and its evolution from idyllic expanse to death-filled tanglewild was a slow, wizard-fueled process, most scholars agree the true beginning of the end was marked by the interdimensional arrival of the Primal Beast.

A creature hatched into an existence devoid of all feeling but hunger and pain, aeons of carnage shaped the Primal Beast into the apex predator on a planet filled with violent terrors. Desperately banished by would-be masters with failed hopes to control him, the Beast was cast into a new world — one where he could ascend from mere hungry predator into an invasive killing machine with nothing able to stand in his way.

For thousands of years, the Mistwood served as massive stomping ground for the Beast's destructive play — and even the feared durana beasts made for tasty snacks. Indeed, there could be no rivals for the Beast's territory, only minor annoyances. Until one such tiny annoyance employed vile trickery to trap the unstoppable Beast in the Gleipnir.

There he might have remained subdued for eternity, were it not for the unpredictable powers of the Continuum Device. Now, freed from both Gleipnir and Vault, far afield from the Mistwood, and much closer to inhabited lands, the Beast sets his snout towards new slaughters and the delights of savage destruction — and the paltry fires of civilization will do little to keep this ageless monster at bay.

* The ability has two main components:
** {{Symbol|Wind-up}} The wind-up component.
** {{Symbol|Projectile|Run}} The charge component.
** The following {{M|disable}} sources completely nullifies the ability cast:
*** {{M|Fear}} sources.
*** Other {{M|forced movement|x}} sources.
*** {{M|Sleep}} sources.

* {{Symbol|Wind-up}}
** The ability is interrupted, and nullified, when affected by the following sources during the wind-up:
*** {{M|Hex}} sources.
*** {{M|Hidden}} sources
*** {{M|Stun}} sources.
*** {{M|Taunt}} sources.
*** When the Beast becomes {{M|invulnerable}}.
*** Upon the Beast's {{M|death}}.
** {{M|Silence}} sources does not interrupt the wind-up. However, it disables the {{A|Primal Beast|Begin Onslaught}} {{M|sub-ability}}.

* {{Symbol|Projectile|Run}}
** Applies the following ability effects on the Beast while charging:
*** {{M|Disarm}}
**** {{cf|Hotkey|A}} Attack orders behaves like {{cf|Hotkey|M}} move orders while disarmed, causing these orders to change the Onslaught direction.
*** Self-{{M|forced movement}}, with a {{#var:Onslaught basic2}}-charge speed.
**** Can charge through impassable terrain.
**** All unit-targeted abilities have an {{M|instant cast}} time and neither requires {{M|Turn Rate|text=turning}} nor {{M|Facing Angle|text=facing}} the unit-targeted enemy to cast, as long as the unit-targeted location is within the {{M|cast range}}.
*** The following {{M|disable}} sources prevents the Beast from changing direction, but do not interrupt the charge:
**** {{M|Hex|x}} sources.
**** {{M|Stun|x}} sources, and additionally pauses the charge until the {{M|debuff}} duration ends.
**** {{M|Taunt|x}} sources.
** {{M|Trees}} within 100-radius around the Beast are destroyed upon contact.

* {{Symbol|Projectile|Run}}
** Can be canceled in the following conditions:
*** Any point-targeted orders that interrupts {{M|channeling}} abilities, including:
**** The {{cf|Hotkey|H}} Hold command.
**** The {{cf|Hotkey|S}} Stop command.
*** When {{M|channeling|x}} {{A|Town Portal Scroll|Teleport}}.

* {{Symbol|Projectile|Run}} The ability effects are applied as follows within {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#var:Onslaught value4}} radius centered around the Beast:
*# The {{M|physical}} {{M|spell damage}} on enemy units.
*# A non-disabling {{M|knockback}} on both ally and enemy units.
*# The {{M|stun}} {{M|debuff}} on enemy units.

* {{M|Trees}} within 100-radius the {{M|knockback}} affected units are destroyed upon contact.

fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** {{M|Disarm}}
** {{Symbol|Channeling}}
*** Does not interrupt [[channeling]] abilities upon cast.
** {{M|Trees}} within {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#var:Trample value1}}-radius centered around the Beast are destroyed upon contact.
** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}}
*** Immediately stomps once upon cast the buff application, without requiring to move.
*** Reapplying the buff while the {{Code|trample}} buff is active does not stomp immediately again.
*** Subsequent pulses are released per accumulated {{#var:Trample value2}}-distance moved on both the x-axis and y-axis.
*** Considers the following movement sources:
**** {{M|Forced movement}} sources.
**** From an offensive {{A|Hurricane Pike|Hurricane Thrust}} cast.
**** {{M|Teleport}} sources, including {{I|Blink Dagger}}-based items.
*** Does not consider the following movement sources:
**** {{A|Force Staff|Force}}
**** An ally {{A|Hurricane Pike|Hurricane Thrust}} cast.
*** Moved distance greater than the distance threshold do not cause the Beast to apply multiple Trample instances at once.
*** Does not Trample if the Beast is moved {{Code|< {{#var:Trample value3}}-distance}} within 0.1 seconds.
** [[File:Dota2 Increased icon.png|21px]]
*** The stomp interval increases by {{#expr:50/{{#var:Trample value2}} round2}} seconds per 50 {{M|movement speed}}.

* The {{M|spell damage}} dealt has the following properties:
** Deals {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage|x}} per stomp interval, and the average damage dealt is defined as:
*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|StompDmg {{=}} {{#var:Trample value4}} + SelfCurrent([[Main Attack Damage|MainAtk]] + [[Bonus Attack Damage|BonusAtk]]) × {{#var:Trample value5}} OR {{ValueColor||{{#var:Trample value5 tal}}|tal|x}}}}
** Utilizes the Beast's current {{M|total attack damage}} value, and neither interacts nor utilizes other attack damage manipulation sources applied to the Beast.
** Hence, the damage value is affected by the following sources sourced from the Beast:
*** {{M|Main attack damage}}
*** {{M|Bonus attack damage}}
** The {{M|spell damage|x}} is not capped at 0 damage.
*** Deals 0 spell damage per stomp instance when the Beast's negative attack damage value is greater than the spell damage value.

* Grants the Beast the following bonuses upon cast:
** {{cf|talnotes}}
*** {{Symbol|bonus t1l}} Stacks multiplicatively with other {{M|magic resistance}} sources.

fields.value:
* The passive component grants the following ability effects:
** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}}
*** Grants 1 buff stack in the following conditions:
**** Per {{#var:Uproar value2}} player-based damage accumulated ([[after reductions]]) within the last {{#var:Uproar value5}} seconds.
***** Considers {{M|Roshan}}'s damage instance as creeps.
**** Considers damage values of all [[damage types]] between {{#var:Uproar value3}} – {{#var:Uproar value4}}, except {{M|HP Removal}} sources.
**** Damage instance taken greater than the threshold do not grant multiple stacks at once.
*** Reapplying the buff refreshes the current stack duration.
*** Does not grant stacks while the ability is on {{M|cooldown}}.
*** Plays an <ab>Primal Beast Uproar 2.mp3</ab> ability sound effect audible to the Beast only upon reaching {{#var:Uproar value1}} [[File:Primal Beast Uproar (Max) abilityicon dota2 gameasset.png|21px|link=#Uproar|Max Stacks]] stacks.

* The active component has the following properties:
** Cannot cast without stacks.
** Both the active component and the {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} do not interrupt the Beast's {{M|channeling}} abilities.
** Has a {{#var:Uproar dt value1}}-second downtime, displayed in red over the ability icon upon cast.
*** Affected by {{A|Faceless Void|Time Dilation}} despite not being affected by {{M|cooldown}} manipulation sources.
*** {{M|Dispel|text=Dispelling}} the {{M|buff}} does not affect the downtime.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} 
*** Grants the following bonuses upon cast correspondingly per stack:
**** Flat {{M|bonus attack damage|x}}.
**** Flat {{M|bonus armor}}.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** Applies a {{M|movement speed}} slow {{M|debuff}} correspondingly per stack within the radius centered around the Beast. 
<hr>
* {{cf|aghnotes}} Adds another active component to Uproar with the following properties:
** Both the first and the splintered ray {{M|projectiles}} have the same properties.
** Cannot be stopped upon cast.
*** Releases {{#var:Uproar type3 value2}} {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} waves, centered on the Beast for the entire duration.
*** Both the {{M|spell damage|x}} and {{M|Break}} applied can affect the same enemy unit twice, once per expanding, once after each ray splits.
*** [[File:Dota2 West.png|31px]] [[File:Dota2 PtoL.png|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] [[File:Dota2 PtoP.png|21px]] {{hi|Primal Beast}} [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]] {{Symbol|Facing Angle|u}} [[File:Dota2 PtoP.png|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-b.png|21px|B]] [[File:Dota2 PtoR.png|21px]] [[File:Dota2 East.png|31px]]
**** The first created {{Code|Line PB}} is a straight line and forms a 180°-angle.
**** {{Code|PO}} and {{Code|OB}} are two [[Wikipedia:Line (geometry)#Ray|rays]] opposite to each other, traveling to the east and west respectively corresponding to the Beast's {{M|facing angle}}.
*** Continues creating rays at the Beast's {{M|death}} location, until it {{M|respawns}}.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{Symbol|Facing Angle|u}} [[File:Dota2 Primal Beast Uproar Trajectory 1 icon.png|84px|Uproar First Rays' Trajectory]]
** {{Code|PO {{=}} OB {{=}} {{#var:Uproar type2 value5 agh}}}} and is defined as:
*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|[[Wikipedia:Line (geometry)#Ray|Ray]]Distance {{=}} [[Projectile Speed|ProjectileSpeed]] × SplitTime}}
** Subsequent rays are created and adapts evenly per {{#invoke:Lua|invoke|module=loop|fn=f|2|4|<nowiki>{{ValueColor||{{#expr:360/{{#var:f}}/2}}°|agh|x}}<sup>th</sup>{{#ifexpr:{{#var:f}}<5|/}}</nowiki>}} angle at 2/3/4/5 stacks, with a cone-shaped area-of-effect.
** The formation diagram above depicts the created rays with {{#var:Uproar value1}} [[File:Primal Beast Uproar (Max) abilityicon dota2 gameasset.png|21px|link=#Uproar|Max Stacks]] stacks upon cast.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{Symbol|Facing Angle|u}} [[File:Dota2 Primal Beast Uproar Trajectory 2 icon.png|84px|Uproar Splintered Rays' Trajectory]]
** {{ValueColor||{{#var:Uproar basic2}}|agh}} seconds after casting, each of the first rays now splinters into {{ValueColor||{{#var:Uproar type3 value2 agh}}|agh}} {{M|projectiles|text=splintered rays}}, with the {{Code|Line OB}} creating [[File:Dota2 Letter-b.png|21px|B]] [[File:Dota2 PtoP.png|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-q.png|21px|Q]] and [[File:Dota2 Letter-b.png|21px|B]] [[File:Dota2 PtoP.png|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-s.png|21px|S]] splintered rays in this example.
*** [[File:Dota2 Primal Beast Uproar Trajectory 3 icon.png|84px|Uproar Max Ray Radius]] {{Code|OQ {{=}} OS {{=}} {{#var:Uproar type2 value1 agh}}}} , {{Code|[[Wikipedia:Angle|∠]] QBS {{=}} {{#expr:{{#explode:{{#var:Uproar type3 value3 agh}}|°}}*2}}°}}
** Each of the splintered rays are angled {{ValueColor||{{#var:Uproar type3 value3 agh}}|agh}} left and right and travels another {{ValueColor||≈823|agh}}-distance.
*** Both {{Code|OBQ}} and {{Code|OBS}} are [[Wikipedia:Triangle#Definition, terminology, and types|obtuse scalene triangles]] with the following properties:
**** {{Code|∠ OBS {{=}} {{#expr:{{#vardefineecho:OBS|(180-{{#explode:{{#var:Uproar type3 value3 agh}}|°}})}}}}°}} , {{Code|∠ OSB {{=}} {{#expr:{{#vardefineecho:OSB|(asin({{#var:Uproar type2 value5 agh}}*sin({{#var:OBS}}*{{G|deg to rad}})/{{#var:Uproar type2 value1 agh}}) round5)*{{G|rad to deg}}}} round3}}°}} , {{Code|∠ OQS {{=}} {{#expr:{{#vardefineecho:OQS|(180-{{#var:OBS}}-{{#var:OSB}})}} round3}}°}}
**** {{Code|BQ {{=}} BS {{=}} ≈{{#expr:({{#var:Uproar type2 value1 agh}}*sin({{#var:OQS}}*{{G|deg to rad}}))/sin({{#var:OBS}}*{{G|deg to rad}}) round3}}-distance}}
** The ray split effect occurs once per Uproar cast, secondary rays do not further splinter.

** {{ValueColor||{{#var:Uproar basic2}}|agh}} seconds after casting, each of the first rays now splinters into {{ValueColor||{{#var:Uproar type3 value2 agh}}|agh}} {{M|projectiles|text=splintered rays}}, with the {{Code|Line OB}} creating [[File:Dota2 Letter-b.png|21px|B]] [[File:Dota2 PtoP.png|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-q.png|21px|Q]] and [[File:Dota2 Letter-b.png|21px|B]] [[File:Dota2 PtoP.png|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-s.png|21px|S]] splintered rays in this example.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_primal_beast
data.bio_loc:
Though the deterioration of the Mistwood and its evolution from idyllic expanse to death-filled tanglewild was a slow, wizard-fueled process, most scholars agree the true beginning of the end was marked by the interdimensional arrival of the Primal Beast.

A creature hatched into an existence devoid of all feeling but hunger and pain, aeons of carnage shaped the Primal Beast into the apex predator on a planet filled with violent terrors. Desperately banished by would-be masters with failed hopes to control him, the Beast was cast into a new world — one where he could ascend from mere hungry predator into an invasive killing machine with nothing able to stand in his way.

For thousands of years, the Mistwood served as massive stomping ground for the Beast's destructive play — and even the feared durana beasts made for tasty snacks. Indeed, there could be no rivals for the Beast's territory, only minor annoyances. Until one such tiny annoyance employed vile trickery to trap the unstoppable Beast in the Gleipnir.

There he might have remained subdued for eternity, were it not for the unpredictable powers of the Continuum Device. Now, freed from both Gleipnir and Vault, far afield from the Mistwood, and much closer to inhabited lands, the Beast sets his snout towards new slaughters and the delights of savage destruction — and the paltry fires of civilization will do little to keep this ageless monster at bay.
data.hype_loc: Rushing savagely through enemies and allies alike, Primal Beast pounds into battle as one born to raise a ruckus. An unavoidable threat amidst any fray, the Beast can punish attackers and relishes grabbing prey to repeatedly slam them against the ground until nothing but mush remains.

abilities.name: primal_beast_onslaught
abilities.desc_loc:
Primal Beast charges up and then runs in the chosen direction, knocking back enemies and allies alike. Enemy units are damaged and stunned on impact. The longer the charge duration, the farther Primal Beast's momentum will carry him. 

 Can be cancelled at any time with the Stop command.
abilities.lore_loc: The Beast's single-minded focus on chosen prey leaves all other considerations scattered in his ruinous wake.

abilities.lore_loc: As the only member of his species to arrive on this world, locals can only speculate on the Beast's size relative to his kin. Such observation would prove easier of course if the subject didn't eat everything it sees and destroy most of what it doesn't.
facets_loc: Trample grants bonus movement speed to Primal Beast and his allies when activated.

The Beast's temper causes every instance of %damage_limit% hero damage or more to grant a stack of Uproar.  

 When activated, Primal Beast releases a roar that slows surrounding enemies and grants the Beast additional attack damage and armor for %roar_duration% seconds based on his current stacks of Uproar.
abilities.lore_loc: Already draped in a broken patchwork of barding and chains upon appearing in the mistwoods, the Beast tolerates no further attempts at subjugation.
notes_loc: Primal Beast cannot gain Uproar stacks from self damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
